definitions.meaning: đun liu riu, đun nhỏ lửa

examples: Simmer the soup for 20 minutes before serving.
Let the sauce simmer until it thickens.

definitions.meaning: thái, băm, chặt (thực phẩm)

examples: Chop the onions finely before adding them to the pan.
She chopped the carrots into small pieces.

definitions.meaning: ướp (thịt, cá) trong nước sốt gia vị

examples: Marinate the chicken in lemon juice and herbs for at least two hours.
The beef tastes better when you marinate it overnight.

definitions.meaning: nướng (trên vỉ, lửa than)
vỉ nướng, lò nướng

examples: We grilled the fish over charcoal for a smoky flavour.
Put the vegetables on the grill for about ten minutes.

definitions.meaning: nhào bột, nhồi bột

examples: Knead the dough for ten minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
She kneaded the bread dough on a floured surface.

definitions.meaning: thái hạt lựu, cắt thành miếng nhỏ vuông

examples: Dice the potatoes into small cubes before roasting them.
The recipe asks you to dice the tomatoes and mix them with olive oil.

definitions.meaning: hấp (thực phẩm bằng hơi nước)

examples: Steam the broccoli for five minutes to keep its nutrients.
We steamed the dumplings instead of frying them.

definitions.meaning: xào nhanh với ít dầu (lửa lớn)

examples: Sauté the garlic in olive oil until golden.
She sautéed the mushrooms with butter and thyme.

definitions.meaning: nướng (thịt, rau) trong lò ở nhiệt độ cao
món nướng (thịt nướng lò)

examples: Roast the chicken at 200°C for about an hour.
Sunday roast with vegetables is a classic British meal.

definitions.meaning: nguyên liệu, thành phần trong món ăn

examples: The main ingredients of this dish are rice, eggs, and vegetables.
Always check the ingredients list before buying packaged food.

definitions.meaning: gia vị, đồ nêm nếm

examples: Add seasoning to taste — salt, pepper, and a pinch of paprika.
The dish lacked seasoning, so it tasted quite bland.

definitions.meaning: xay nhuyễn, trộn đều (bằng máy xay)

examples: Blend the fruit and yoghurt together to make a smoothie.
She blended the soup until it was completely smooth.

definitions.meaning: gọt vỏ, lột vỏ (rau, củ, quả)
vỏ (của trái cây, rau củ)

examples: Peel the potatoes before boiling them.
Add a strip of lemon peel to the tea for extra flavour.

definitions.meaning: chắt nước, để ráo nước (sau khi luộc, rửa)

examples: Drain the pasta and rinse it with cold water.
Drain the canned beans before adding them to the salad.

definitions.meaning: khuấy, trộn (thức ăn đang nấu)

examples: Stir the porridge continuously so it doesn't stick to the pot.
She stirred the cake batter until it was smooth.

definitions.meaning: nướng (trong lò) — thường cho bánh, bánh mì

examples: Bake the cake at 180°C for 30 minutes.
She loves to bake bread on weekends.

definitions.meaning: mềm, dễ nhai (mô tả thức ăn đã chín đúng)

examples: Cook the beef until it is tender and falls apart easily.
The vegetables were perfectly tender — not too soft or too crunchy.

definitions.meaning: giòn, crunchy (mô tả thức ăn có lớp vỏ giòn)

examples: The fried chicken was crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside.
Everyone loves crispy bacon in the morning.

definitions.meaning: mặn mà, đậm đà (vị ngon không ngọt)

examples: I prefer savoury snacks like cheese crackers over sweet ones.
The soup had a rich, savoury flavour from the herbs and stock.

definitions.meaning: khẩu phần, suất ăn

examples: The restaurant serves generous portions at a reasonable price.
She divided the pasta into equal portions for the family.

definitions.meaning: ẩm thực, phong cách nấu ăn (của một quốc gia)

examples: Italian cuisine is famous for its pasta, pizza, and use of olive oil.
She took a cooking class to learn more about Japanese cuisine.

definitions.meaning: chín (trái cây, rau quả sẵn sàng để ăn)

examples: Choose ripe bananas — they should be yellow with a few brown spots.
The avocado is ripe when it feels slightly soft when pressed.

definitions.meaning: thức ăn thừa, đồ ăn còn lại sau bữa ăn

examples: We had leftovers from dinner, so we ate them for lunch the next day.
Leftover rice can be turned into a quick fried rice dish.

definitions.meaning: công thức nấu ăn

examples: She found a great recipe for chocolate cake online.
Follow the recipe carefully to get the best results.

definitions.meaning: trang trí, rắc lên trên món ăn trước khi phục vụ
đồ trang trí món ăn (rau thơm, lát chanh…)

examples: Garnish the soup with fresh parsley and a drizzle of cream.
A simple garnish of lemon slices makes the dish look more appealing.
